title: Claude Sonnet 4.6 System Card
paper_type_zh: 闭源前沿模型系统卡与数据披露账本
best_for_zh: 审计闭源前沿模型报告中已披露与未披露的训练数据、反馈、审计和可复现性边界
one_line: The Claude Sonnet 4.6 System Card reports broad proprietary training-source categories, deduplication/classification, post-training, reinforcement from AI feedback, and worker preference/safety roles, while record-level data, reward, and recipe details remain undisclosed.
《Claude Sonnet 4.6 System Card》披露了宽泛的专有训练数据类别、去重/分类、后训练、来自 AI 的强化反馈以及人工偏好和安全工作角色，但记录级数据、奖励契约和训练配方仍未公开。
why: It provides an auditable closed-frontier baseline: readers can distinguish the disclosed source categories, high-level feedback methods, and safety-audit practice from the missing data lineage, reward contract, rollout policy, and reproducibility evidence needed to reuse or independently assess a reasoning-data pipeline.
inclusion_reason: A 2026 Anthropic system card that explicitly discloses broad training-source categories, deduplication/classification, post-training and fine-tuning, reinforcement from AI feedback, worker preference/safety roles, and some reinforcement-learning transcript screening while leaving the underlying data and feedback contracts largely undisclosed.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Frontier system cards can disclose that models receive post-training, AI feedback, and human preference/safety work without exposing the records or feedback contract needed to evaluate those claims. The resulting gap is especially important for an audit of data provenance, reward design, contamination, and reproducibility.

Claude Sonnet 4.6 is therefore included as a disclosure ledger rather than as a reusable data release. The official materials make some broad source and process claims checkable, while leaving the record-level training and evaluation evidence unavailable.

前沿系统卡可以披露模型接受了后训练、AI 反馈以及人工偏好/安全工作，却不公开检验这些说法所需的记录或反馈契约。这会直接限制对数据来源、奖励设计、污染和可复现性的审计。

因此，Claude Sonnet 4.6 被收录为数据披露账本，而非可复用数据发布。官方材料使一部分宽泛的数据来源和流程主张可以核查，但记录级的训练与评测证据仍不可得。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The official system card names five broad proprietary training-source categories: public Internet information up to May 2025, non-public third-party data, labeling-service and paid-contractor data, opted-in Claude-user data, and internally generated data. It also reports cleaning and filtering, substantial post-training and fine-tuning, and reinforcement from AI feedback in the Transparency Hub.

For Track 12, the useful object is the boundary of this disclosure. The report identifies high-level feedback and worker roles, including preference selection, safety evaluation, adversarial testing, and automatic screening of a significant fraction of reinforcement-learning training transcripts, but it does not release the corresponding records, reward/verifier, or optimization recipe.

官方系统卡列出了五类宽泛的专有训练来源：截至 2025 年 5 月的公共互联网信息、非公开第三方数据、标注服务与受薪承包者数据、选择加入的 Claude 用户数据，以及 Anthropic 内部生成的数据。该卡还报告了清洗与过滤、大量后训练和微调；Transparency Hub 进一步列出来自 AI 的强化反馈。

对 Track 12 而言，关键对象是这些披露的边界。报告指出了高层次的反馈和工作人员角色，包括偏好选择、安全评估、对抗测试，以及对相当一部分强化学习训练转录的自动筛查；但它没有公开对应记录、奖励/验证器或优化配方。

title: Method
方法
html:
The card reports a general-purpose web crawler that respects robots.txt and does not access password-protected, sign-in-protected, or CAPTCHA-protected pages. It reports cleaning and filtering that include deduplication and classification. It names the broad source mixture but does not provide source manifests, weights, counts, revisions, rights mapping, classifier versions, thresholds, ordering, or removal yields.

The official materials state that Sonnet 4.6 underwent substantial post-training and fine-tuning for helpfulness, honesty, and harmlessness. The Transparency Hub lists reinforcement from AI feedback and selected character-trait training. The system card says data-work-platform workers help through preference selection, safety evaluation, and adversarial testing; it also says automatic screening covered a significant fraction of reinforcement-learning training transcripts. These statements do not identify which data entered post-training, the feedback record schema, candidate sets, reward/verifier, calibration, aggregation, RL objective, optimizer, rollout policy, schedules, or checkpoint selection.

The card describes extended and adaptive thinking with a user-directed effort parameter, but that is a deployment interface. It does not disclose the training rollout budget, allocation policy, or a reproducible inference protocol.

该卡报告了一个遵守 robots.txt 的通用网页爬虫，且不访问受密码、登录或 CAPTCHA 保护的页面。它报告了包括去重和分类在内的清洗与过滤。报告列出了宽泛的来源混合，但未给出来源清单、权重、数量、版本、权利映射、分类器版本、阈值、处理顺序或移除产出。

官方材料称 Sonnet 4.6 经历了以有帮助、诚实和无害为目标的大量后训练与微调。Transparency Hub 列出来自 AI 的强化反馈和选定的性格特征训练。系统卡称数据工作平台的人员通过偏好选择、安全评估和对抗测试提供帮助；还称对相当一部分强化学习训练转录进行了自动筛查。这些说法未说明哪些数据进入了后训练，也未公开反馈记录模式、候选集合、奖励/验证器、校准、聚合、RL 目标、优化器、rollout 策略、训练日程或检查点选择。

该卡描述了带有用户可指定 effort 参数的 extended thinking 和 adaptive thinking，但这属于部署接口。它没有披露训练 rollout 预算、分配策略或可复现的推理协议。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The system card directly supports the broad source categories, crawler boundary, cleaning/filtering, post-training, and worker-role claims. Its page 67 alignment investigation says that automatic screening covered a significant fraction of reinforcement-learning training transcripts. Page 74 reports review of earlier training snapshots that found hallucinated tool results, ignored or misrepresented tool failures, over-eager behavior, answer thrashing, and rarer observations such as fabricated citations and unreported prompt-injection attempts.

The report explicitly separates automated behavioral-audit scenarios from training: page 84 says the scenarios inform high-level training decisions, but are not used as training scenarios or environments specifically targeting those metrics. It also notes that online evaluation information may have appeared in training data and points to a general decontamination discussion for Claude Opus 4.5; a Sonnet-4.6-specific protocol or quantified outcome is not given.

The card says evaluation informed deployment under ASL-3 and that no in-depth alignment-focused third-party assessment was arranged. These are release and assessment disclosures, not evidence of released training data, a reward contract, or a reproducible post-training pipeline.

系统卡直接支持宽泛的来源类别、爬虫边界、清洗/过滤、后训练和工作人员角色等主张。其第 67 页的对齐调查称，自动筛查覆盖了相当一部分强化学习训练转录。第 74 页报告，对较早训练快照的审查发现了幻觉式工具结果、忽略或歪曲工具失败、过度急切的行为、答案反复摇摆，以及较少见的伪造引用和未报告的提示注入尝试。

报告明确把自动化行为审计场景与训练分开：第 84 页称，这些场景为高层训练决策提供信息，但并非专门面向这些指标构建的训练场景或训练环境。报告还指出在线评测信息可能出现在训练数据中，并将读者引向 Claude Opus 4.5 的一般去污染讨论；但没有给出 Sonnet 4.6 特定的协议或量化结果。

该卡称评测为 ASL-3 部署提供了信息，并称未安排深入、以对齐为重点的第三方评估。这些是发布与评估披露，而非训练数据、奖励契约或可复现后训练流水线已发布的证据。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The contribution for this atlas is not a new open training corpus. Its value is that an official frontier report makes several layers of a closed pipeline visible at once: broad source classes, web-collection constraints, cleaning, AI-feedback language, worker roles, transcript screening, training-snapshot observations, audit boundaries, and contamination caveats.

This breadth makes it possible to state a precise negative result: the report supports high-level provenance and process claims, but not source-to-record lineage, a reusable preference or trajectory dataset, a reward/verifier contract, or a reproducible reinforcement-learning recipe.

该条目对本图谱的贡献并不是一个新的开放训练语料。它的价值在于，一份官方前沿报告同时使闭源流水线的若干层次可见：宽泛来源类别、网页采集约束、清洗、AI 反馈表述、工作人员角色、转录筛查、训练快照观察、审计边界和污染提示。

这种覆盖面使我们能够得出精确的反面结论：报告支持高层次的来源与流程主张，但不支持来源到记录的谱系、可复用的偏好或轨迹数据集、奖励/验证器契约，或可复现的强化学习配方。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
All named data sources are category-level disclosures. The report does not release source manifests, mixture weights, record/token counts, rights, consent records, data versions, item-level provenance, training/evaluation splits, or Sonnet-specific benchmark-overlap controls. It likewise does not release post-training examples, preference pairs, reasoning traces, tool trajectories, or feedback schemas.

Reinforcement from AI feedback, worker preference/safety roles, and transcript screening should not be promoted into a disclosed RLAIF or RLVR recipe. Reward/verifier identity and versions, labels, calibration, thresholds, coverage, aggregation, optimization, sampling, rollouts, and failure analyses are unknown. Evaluation and behavioral-audit scenarios must not be treated as training data because the card gives an explicit contrary boundary.

The report documents some observed training-snapshot issues but does not provide their incidence, underlying records, mitigation logs, or persistence in the released model. No official code, data, arXiv record, DOI, or verified BibTeX entry was identified.

所有被点名的数据来源都只是类别级披露。报告未发布来源清单、混合权重、记录/词元数量、权利、同意记录、数据版本、条目级来源、训练/评测划分或 Sonnet 特定的基准重叠控制。同样也未发布后训练样例、偏好对、推理轨迹、工具轨迹或反馈模式。

来自 AI 的强化反馈、人工偏好/安全角色和转录筛查不应被拔高为已披露的 RLAIF 或 RLVR 配方。奖励/验证器的身份和版本、标签、校准、阈值、覆盖率、聚合、优化、采样、rollout 以及失败分析均为未知。评测和行为审计场景不能被视为训练数据，因为该卡已明确给出相反边界。

报告记录了一些观察到的训练快照问题，但未提供其发生率、底层记录、缓解日志或其是否持续存在于已发布模型中的证据。未识别到官方代码、数据、arXiv 记录、DOI 或已验证的 BibTeX 条目。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Use this card to compare a frontier provider's reported post-training and safety process against the evidence needed to independently audit a reasoning-data pipeline. It is particularly useful when distinguishing a named data category, AI-feedback statement, worker role, or audit practice from a released dataset, verifier, evaluator, or training recipe.

For future disclosure, the missing ledger identifies concrete high-value fields: source manifests and rights, record schemas and counts, post-training stage allocation, feedback and reward specifications, sampling and optimization details, split and contamination evidence, environment pins, and audit/mitigation logs.

可使用本卡将前沿提供方报告的后训练和安全流程，与独立审计推理数据流水线所需的证据进行对照。它尤其适合区分：被点名的数据类别、AI 反馈表述、工作人员角色或审计实践，和一个已发布的数据集、验证器、评测器或训练配方之间的差别。

对于未来的数据披露，缺失账本指出了一组具体且高价值的字段：来源清单和权利、记录模式和数量、后训练阶段分配、反馈与奖励规格、采样与优化细节、数据划分与污染证据、环境版本固定，以及审计/缓解日志。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read the system card's training-source disclosure as category-level evidence, not as a source manifest or a data release.
  • Keep the reported AI feedback, worker roles, and transcript screening separate from an undisclosed reward/verifier and reinforcement-learning recipe.
  • Treat the stated audit and evaluation contamination boundaries as constraints on what can be inferred from reported evaluations.
  • Use the observed training-snapshot issues as a risk ledger; their prevalence and mitigation remain undisclosed.

• 将系统卡中的训练来源披露视为类别级证据，而不是来源清单或数据发布。
  • 将报告的 AI 反馈、工作人员角色和转录筛查，与未披露的奖励/验证器和强化学习配方严格区分。
  • 将已说明的审计和评测污染边界视为从评测结果进行推断时的约束。
  • 将观察到的训练快照问题作为风险账本；其发生率与缓解情况仍未披露。
